name: Heart-Healthy Diet (DASH-style)
description: Limits sodium, saturated fat and trans fat, and sets a fiber target for cardiovascular risk reduction.
disclaimer: Thresholds are illustrative and codified from public guidance. Verify against your institution's approved diet manual before clinical use.

rules.title: Daily sodium limit

evidence.source: DASH diet (NHLBI); US Dietary Guidelines for Americans
evidence.note: Standard DASH allows up to 2,300 mg sodium per day.

rules.remedy: Choose fresh foods and no-salt-added products.

rules.title: Saturated fat share of energy

evidence.source: AHA Dietary Guidance to Improve Cardiovascular Health; DASH diet
evidence.note: Aim for roughly 5-6% of calories from saturated fat.

rules.remedy: Replace butter, fatty meat and full-fat dairy with unsaturated fat sources.

rules.title: Trans fat share of energy

evidence.note: Trans fat intake should be less than 1% of total energy.

rules.remedy: Remove foods made with partially hydrogenated oils.

rules.title: Fiber density

evidence.note: Aim for about 14 g fiber per 1,000 kcal.

rules.remedy: Add whole grains, legumes, vegetables or fruit.

rules.title: Discouraged processed foods

evidence.source: AHA Dietary Guidance to Improve Cardiovascular Health
evidence.note: Limit processed meats and fried foods.

rules.remedy: Choose lean, unprocessed proteins and baked or steamed preparations.

evidence.note: At least three eating occasions are expected per day.
